trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. Follow the Roadmap tab in order: story first, then the 100% checklist, then the side finales and cleanup. Budget around 200 hours; the list is long rather than hard.
tips: The platinum pops by itself once the other 54 trophies are earned — there is no separate task for it.
Watch the counter in the checklist: when it reads 54 of 55, this one is next.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.target: 100% on the in-game checklist (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion)
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game checklist, which only appears after the story (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion) — but work you did earlier already counts. tips: Open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion in the game to see the checklist — only its rows count.
Stop each activity once its row is met; the checklist asks for part of most sets, not everything.

trophies.guide: At the Kolt & Associates bowling alley — Kingpin Bowling, an illegal operation you visit in Chapter 2 — take all three key valuables and escape: the luxury watch in an office, the shotgun on a table, and the contents of the office safe, which you blow open with a Sticky Bomb. Bring Sticky Bombs with you. If you leave something behind, the operation comes back later, so it is not missable.
tips: Bowl at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley in Kingpin Bowling.
Follow-through is the description's word for the bowling action — play a game there.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reported method: bring Jason and Lucia's Strength to maximum together. Buy a gym membership and train with your partner there, since the partner trains alongside you — the trophy is reported to pop once both characters reach maximum Strength. This is a reported method, not a fully confirmed one: treat the gym grind as the plan, check the trophy after each session, and spend nothing else on it until a source confirms the trigger.
tips: The description gives only a hint — a partnership with mass appeal — so the exact trigger is not spelled out.
This is a hidden trophy; the description is the only official clue.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. Robberies, fights and other criminal acts all feed the counter, so it fills up without a separate grind if you play the side content — check Progress to see where you stand and keep robbing and fighting until it pops.
tips: Make 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile; the count is cumulative.
The counter climbs as you play, so this one pops on its own over a long playthrough.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a cumulative $250,000 in marked bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from bank and payday loan jobs — sell them to your contacts to launder them. The total is cumulative across the whole game, and the 100% checklist wants the same $250,000, so this pops on the road to A Long Road.
tips: Launder $250,000 of marked bills through your contacts; the total is cumulative.
Marked bills come from robberies — fence them steadily and the total climbs.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across all shops — every kind of shop counts and the total is cumulative. Weapons, clothes, food and car parts all add up, so buy what you need for the other trophies and this fills itself in. Do not waste money on things you will never use just to rush it.
tips: Spend $100,000 across all shops; the total is cumulative.
Big purchases count fastest — garages and weapons move the total quicker than small items.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all eight garage properties in the Vice City Real Estate app, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. Together they cost about $160,000 — garages the story gives you do not count, so buy all eight. Buy them early: each one gives you space to register vehicles for On the Spot.
tips: Buy all 8 garage properties.
Together they cost about $160,000, so robberies first will pay for them.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles through the Scooter Bros app, which opens with the Chapter 2 mission Moses. Take a stolen car to Moses, choose Respray, then Register. From Chapter 3 you can also register cars with a standard tracker at Pay 'n' Spray. Each car needs a free garage space, so buy garages first and register cheap cars.
tips: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
The app opens with the mission Moses, so this trophy only starts after that mission.
